clips.title: The story
paras: Silverwing Sentinels gather at Silverwing Grove in south-central Ashenvale, near Fallen Sky Lake. From this fortified hollow, night elf warriors muster Alliance forces against the Warsong Clan loggers cutting through the forest.

At Silverwing Grove, Silverwing Sentinels gather beneath the canopy southwest of Silverwing Outpost. The night elves use the post to oppose the Horde's lumbering in Warsong Gulch. Alliance officers, provisions, and scouts assemble here to organize skirmishes and muster champions. They defend Ashenvale against orcish expansion.
